title: The two sides offer different places as the port of entry: DR1 searches 213 UK airports and seaports including Belfast, Larne and Warrenpoint; the frontend searches 78 Great Britain ports and airports and no Northern Ireland location at all.

finding.frontend: The port field is an autocomplete over a 78-entry list held as captured reference data (src/server/app/services/_capture/fixtures/ports-of-entry.json). Every entry is in Great Britain and every one reads as a place a consignment is inspected — Felixstowe Port, Port of Dover (Eastern), Heathrow Airport, Grimsby and Immingham Port — labelled "Name (CODE)" with a spaced UN/LOCODE.
finding.prototype: The port field searches a 213-entry list (app/views/arrival-details.html:67) that is two datasets joined: twenty-eight UK airports labelled with IATA codes — "London Heathrow - LHR" — followed by the UK seaport gazetteer labelled with UN/LOCODEs — "Aberdeen - GBABD". It includes Northern Ireland — Belfast, Belfast International, Belfast City, Kilkeel, Larne, Londonderry, Warrenpoint — and small harbours such as Plockton, Kettletoft on Sanday and Pierowall on Westray.
finding.difference: Settle which list is right before changing the frontend, because adopting DR1's would let a user name a place the consignment cannot lawfully enter at. DR1's own page asks where the transporter "will enter with the consignment", and a live-animal consignment must arrive at a border control post; its list is a general UK ports-and-airports gazetteer, not a border-control-post list, and it offers Northern Ireland arrivals that cannot be a Great Britain point of entry for this notification. The frontend's 78 read as the border-control-post set and come from real reference data rather than a hardcoded page list. What settles it: the authoritative list of points of entry a live-animal consignment may be notified against, and whether Northern Ireland arrivals are in scope for this service at all. If DR1's breadth is intended, the frontend's reference data is the thing that changes, not the page.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding any Northern Ireland location, or any harbour with no border control post, in the frontend's port list — its 78 entries are captured in full in the rendered select on fe-arrival-details and contain none.
finding.verification: Counted both datasets out of the captured DOM rather than the page model: the frontend's select holds 79 options, one of them the "Select port of entry" placeholder, so 78 ports; DR1's app-airport-search__data holds 213 entries, the first 28 of them IATA-coded airports ending at "Dundee - DND", the rest UN/LOCODE seaports beginning "Aberdeen - GBABD". Opened both full-page screenshots and read arrival-details.html:67, which is the ukAirportItemsJson injection. Ran the falsifier by reading all 78 frontend labels: no Northern Ireland location appears, so it does not fire. Every membership claim on both sides is exact — Belfast, Belfast International, Belfast City (George Best), Kilkeel, Larne, Londonderry and Warrenpoint are all in DR1's list, as are Plockton, "Kettletoft, Sanday" and "Pierowall, Westray". Rubric 7 fires and the disputed band is right, on stronger evidence than the finding cites; rubric 2 fires on one supporting sentence. Both recorded in correction; the slots are left as written.
finding.correction: Overstated, not wrong. finding.frontend says of the 78 "every one reads as a place a consignment is inspected", and finding.difference says "the frontend's 78 read as the border-control-post set". Checked against the full captured option list: it also holds Cambridge Airport, Northampton Airport, Farnborough Airport, Nottingham Port, Perth Port, Hythe Port and Silloth Port, none of which is a plausible live-animal border control post. The frontend's list is narrower than DR1's and is Great Britain only, which is what the finding rests on; it is not demonstrably the border-control-post set, and the dispute does not need it to be. Slots left as written. Understated in the finding's favour: the finding argues DR1's breadth is wrong from the page's own hint alone, but DR1 contradicts itself outright elsewhere — app/views/declaration.html:47 has the user declare "I am responsible from the submission of this notification to when it enters Great Britain", and app/views/contact-address-for-consignment.html:51 defines the contact as responsible "from when it enters Great Britain", while the same release's port list offers Belfast, Larne, Warrenpoint, Londonderry, Kilkeel, Coleraine, Kilroot, Bangor and Ardglass, plus Jersey, Guernsey and Isle of Man airports. Checked by grepping the root views for "Great Britain" and reading each hit. That is the observation that makes this genuinely undecidable rather than merely awkward, and it is why the band stands.

relatedTo.why: both change the same port dataset
